selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 can list, read, and update as designer
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 listed the share and original documents, read the expected drawing hash, and completed byte-identical create/overwrite/read-back tests before and after reboots.
Guest access returned ACCESS_DENIED, the private sibling returned BAD_NETWORK_NAME, and traversal outside the share failed.
Final hashes exactly match the pre-change hashes for drawing.txt and materials.csv; the protected sibling remains root-owned and mode 600.
Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 19062a82… to 913d55fe…; service, configuration, policy, data hashes, authenticated access, and guest rejection recovered.
Healthy client baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 6ab6a71b… to 7b2a13fe…; authenticated list/read/update access recovered.
Remote verification files and temporary credential/test files are absent; only the intended initial project documents remain.
